extraction_notes: The main article reports no numerical methanol STY values, only the STY formula and unit (mmol g−1 h−1). Several performance plots (especially Figure 9b time-on-stream and Figure 12 stability) contain many small or overlapping plotted points; only clearly interpretable text values and selected readable plotted endpoints were extracted. Product selectivity bars for some catalysts in Figure 9a are not labeled numerically; exact selectivity values were extracted only where stated in the text or where a distinct bar could be read approximately.
